edits.old: Then one entry with decision code "AC-DENY" and reason "BANK_IDENTITY_ON_PARTNER_ROUTE" is written
edits.new:
Then one entry with decision code "AC-DENY" and reason "BANK_IDENTITY_ON_PARTNER_ROUTE" is written

  Scenario: AC10 A partner identity with no second factor gets no role (exception X3, BR1)
    Given the claims of "P-5101" for "LF-0012" carry "amr" holding "pwd" only on the partner route
    When the gateway calls the resolution for "P-5101"
    Then the call returns status 401 with message MSG-P4-005 and no role is answered
    Then one entry with decision code "AC-DENY" is written

  Scenario: AC11 A claim with no usable partner role is refused (exception X4, BR2)
    Given the claims of "P-5101" name a role code that no role row holds, or a role of class "BANK_USER"
    When the gateway calls the resolution for "P-5101"
    Then the call returns status 401 with message MSG-P4-001 and no role is answered

  Scenario: AC12 Two partner roles, or a partner role with a bank role, are refused (exception X5, BR3)
    Given the claims of "P-5101" name "PT-LAWFIRM" and "PT-VALUER"
    When the gateway calls the resolution for "P-5101"
    Then the call returns status 403 with message MSG-P4-006 naming both codes
    Then one entry with decision code "AC-DENY" and reason "ROLE_CONFLICT" is written

  Scenario: AC13 A firm that is not active is refused (exception X6, BR5)
    Given the claim gives the firm state "SUSPENDED" for "LF-0012"
    When the gateway calls the resolution for "P-5101"
    Then the call returns status 403 with message MSG-P4-008
    Then one entry with decision code "AC-DENY" and reason "PARTNER_NOT_ACTIVE" is written

  Scenario: AC14 An identity with no active binding to a firm is refused (exception X7, BR11)
    Given the claims of "P-5101" assert no active binding to a firm
    When the gateway calls the resolution for "P-5101"
    Then the call returns status 401 with message MSG-P4-001
    Then one entry with decision code "AC-DENY" and reason "NO_PARTNER_BINDING" is written

  Scenario: AC15 A partner user is answered at the versions in force, as a bank user is (BR6)
    Given masking version "MASK-SIT-01" is in force
    When the gateway calls the resolution for "P-5101" signed in for "LF-0012" as "PT-LAWFIRM"
    Then the answer carries matrix version "PM-2026.11" and masking version "MASK-SIT-01"

  Scenario: AC16 The resolution reads no partner table (BR8)
    Given the rwb-partner contract mock returns partner "LF-0012" as a LAW_FIRM with panel status "ACTIVE"
    When the gateway calls the resolution for "P-5101" signed in for "LF-0012" as "PT-LAWFIRM"
    Then the answer is built from the claims and the rows of role, permission and masking_rule only

  Scenario: AC17 A personal field or a credential in the claims is refused (exception X11, BR9, BR10)
    Given the claims of "P-5101" carry a personal field or a token
    When the gateway calls the resolution for "P-5101"
    Then the field is rejected before any read with the field named and no role is answered
    Then the request is logged with the field name only and never its value

  Scenario: AC18 No answer is served after its expiry (exception X8, BR12)
    Given "P-5101" was resolved and the token expiry the gateway supplied has passed
    When the partner calls the resolution again
    Then the call returns status 401 with message MSG-P4-001 and no stale role is served

  Scenario: AC19 The resolution stays behind the feature flag (BR13)
    Given the feature flag "rwb.access.partner-signin" is off
    When the gateway calls the resolution for "P-5101"
    Then the operation answers status 404 and no partner session resolves
